2363-4659-5224-7729.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {2}.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Hangarback Walker resolves, entering with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1704-2757-4493-5362.notablePrerequisites: This combo has a chance of failure based on the amount of starting mana you have and your first few coin flips. It may take significantly more or less mana than the amount shown. See the widget below for calculations.
1704-2757-4493-5362.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping an untapped creature you control, untapping a basic land.
Activate that basic land by tapping it, adding one mana.
Repeat until there are no more available creatures to tap.
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying its mana cost, targeting Krark.
When you cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication, Krark and any additional copies of Krark trigger.
Resolve all Krark triggers, copying Irenicus's Vile Duplication for each flip you won, and returning the original to your hand as long as you lost at least one flip.
Resolve each copy of Irenicus's Vile Duplication, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Krark each time.
If Irenicus's Vile Duplication is back in your hand, repeat from step 1.
If you won every flip, instead resolve the Irenicus's Vile Duplication card itself, creating one more Krark token and putting the card into your graveyard.
Repeat steps 1 through 9 with Quantum Misalignment, if you still need more Krark copies.
If you manage to pass a critical threshold of Krark copies before both Irenicus's Vile Duplication and Quantum Misalignment end up in your graveyard, this combo is overwhelmingly likely to be an infinite loop from that point on. See the widget below for failure chances.
Once you have infinite mana and infinite copies of Krark, you can repeat this loop with any instant or sorcery you can cast.

745-3518-3605-5131.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Mirrorhall Mimic by paying {3}{U}, causing it to enter with an additional Spirit type as a copy of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Dance of the Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from the graveyard to the battlefield tapped with Dance of the Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

2226-2950-5921.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-2950-5921.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Fractured Realm.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Aven Surveyor by paying its mana cost.
When Aven Surveyor enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

955-4316-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2738-4871-5256-5687.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Skittering Precursor, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1325-2438-5170-6132.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Kheru Bloodsucker triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Kheru Bloodsucker trigger.
Resolve the Kheru Bloodsucker trigger, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2060-4415-7889.description:
Cast Stonecloaker by paying its mana cost.
Dancing from Dark to Dawn's first ability triggers, putting three +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Stonecloaker spell. When it enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.

2523-2869-3388.description:
Cast Moritte of the Frost by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Ratadrabik.
Put Moritte of the Frost into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Moritte of the Frost dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Moritte of the Frost that is a copy of Ratadrabik but is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Moritte of the Frost token instead.
2523-2869-3388.notes: This combo produces a mandatory infinite loop that'll cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

5704-7500.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures with power 4 or greater.

1765-2440-4885-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Chishiro's triggers, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1765-2440-4885-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced if you control more Spirits.

240-2079-2511-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat from step 2.

2511-2730-5987.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity.
When Angel of Indemnity dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Angel of Indemnity
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1661-3713-5078-6723.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-5359-7060.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5359-7060.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Threefold Thunderhulk as attackers.
Threefold Thunderhulk triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1164-4996-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 6 or higher.
1164-4996-6900.description:
Activate Mirror of Fate by tapping and sacrificing it, exiling your library.
Cast Beacon of Immortality by paying {5}{W}, doubling your life total and shuffling it into your library.
Cast Beacon of Immortality from the top of your library by paying 6 life, doubling your life total and shuffling it into your library.
Repeat step 3.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3292-3892-6633.description:
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
392-3292-3892-6633.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

934-3767-3918-4002.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
934-3767-3918-4002.description:
Activate Trazyn using Sceptre of Eternal Glory's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2829-3604-5365.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Clue token.
2829-3604-5365.description:
Cast Lonis by paying {1}{G/U}{G/U}.
When Lonis enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Lonis.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat from step 3.
2829-3604-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

222-413-527-4359.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-413-527-4359.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala enter, Slimefoot and Squee triggers once and Blasting Station triggers twice.
Resolve both Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Pinnacle Monk

2103-2665-5913.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Pinnacle Monk.
When the token Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1339-4875-5611.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to draw a card.
"Sliver" chosen with Conspiracy.
1339-4875-5611.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate the Insect by tapping it and discarding a card, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

955-1069-1374-5499--24.notablePrerequisites:
You control three or more artifacts.
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
955-1069-1374-5499--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

157-372-3742.description:
Cast Phantom Steed by paying {3}{U}.
When Phantom Steed enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Detention Sphere to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Detention Sphere enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Abdel Adrian to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Detention Sphere and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Detention Sphere leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Phantom Steed to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Plargg, Dean of Chaos // Augusta, Dean of Order

339-2011-4784.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Jegantha.
339-2011-4784.description:
Declare Jegantha and any other desired creature(s) as attackers.
Augusta triggers, as well as Najeela for each Warrior that was declared an attacker.
Resolve the Najeela trigger(s), if applicable, creating that many 1/1 Warrior creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Augusta trigger, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

891-2386-2579-4050.notablePrerequisites: Pattern of Rebirth attached to Boonweaver Giant.
891-2386-2579-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant, adding one mana of any color.
When Boonweaver Giant dies, The Cauldron of Eternity and Pattern of Rebirth trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Eternity trigger, putting Boonweaver Giant on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Pattern of Rebirth trigger, putting Boonweaver Giant from your library onto the battlefield.
When Boonweaver Giant enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Pattern of Rebirth from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Repeat.

360-1462-2232-2413-2768.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 8.
You have not cast a spell using Demon of Fate's Design's ability this turn.
You control at least seven nontoken creatures.
360-1462-2232-2413-2768.description:
Cast Day of the Dragons by paying 7 life due to Demon of Fate's Design.
When Day of the Dragons enters the battlefield, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Day of the Dragons trigger, exiling all creatures you control and creating that many 5/5 Dragon creature tokens.
When the Dragon(s) enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers that many times.
Resolve all but one Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the final Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Day of the Dragons to your hand from the battlefield.
When Day of the Dragons leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice all Dragons you control and return all cards exiled with Day of the Dragons to the battlefield.
 When the creatures that were exiled by Day of the Dragons enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and Soul Warden trigger that many times.
Resolve all Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life equal to the number of creatures that entered the battlefield.
Resolve all Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If you control eight or more nontoken creatures, this combo nets infinite life.

122-413-1545-1734.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying {1}{W}{W}.
Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, Blasting Station and Trostani.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain life equal to Fiend Hunter's toughness.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Phyrexian Delver until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Phyrexian Delver from exile to the battlefield.
Phyrexian Delver enters the battlefield, triggering itself, Blasting Station and Trostani.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain life equal to Phyrexian Delver's toughness.
Resolve the Phyrexian Delver trigger, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose three life.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Blasting Station abilities, dealing infinite damage to any target(s).

719-4302-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
719-4302-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Xenograft, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

3843-4050-4805-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Primeval Spawn, adding {1}.
When Primeval Spawn dies, its second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Primeval Spawn on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Primeval Spawn trigger, exiling the top ten cards of your library, and casting Primeval Spawn by paying a total of {1} due to Chorus of the Conclave.
Repeat.

814-1651-2751-4050.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three Soldiers.
Myrel does not have summoning sickness.
814-1651-2751-4050.description:
Declare Myrel as an attacker, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Myrel's ability.
Resolve the copy of Myrel's ability, creating at least three 1/1 Soldier artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Soldiers, untapping Strionic Resonator.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Soldiers, adding {2}.
Repeat from step 2.

1003-1306-2303-2538.description:
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, causing each player to return a permanent from the battlefield to their hand whenever you would next draw a card this turn.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Vedalken Archmage triggers, causing each player to return a permanent from the battlefield to their hand, with you returning Mana Crypt, due to Words of Wind.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, causing each player to return a permanent from the battlefield to their hand whenever you would next draw a card this turn.
Cast Mana Crypt by paying {0}.
Vedalken Archmage triggers, causing each player to return a permanent from the battlefield to their hand, with you returning Phyrexian Walker, due to Words of Wind.
Repeat.

1306-1482-2303-2538.description:
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, causing each player to return a permanent from the battlefield to their hand whenever you would next draw a card this turn.
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying {0}.
Vedalken Archmage triggers, causing each player to return a permanent from the battlefield to their hand, with you returning Mana Crypt, due to Words of Wind.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, causing each player to return a permanent from the battlefield to their hand whenever you would next draw a card this turn.
Cast Mana Crypt by paying {0}.
Vedalken Archmage triggers, causing each player to return a permanent from the battlefield to their hand, with you returning Jeweled Lotus, due to Words of Wind.
Repeat.

147-1638-2060-2445.description:
Cast Quandrix Command by paying its mana cost, choosing its first and third modes.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Quandrix Command, with the copy's first mode targeting Dualcaster Mage and the copy's third mode targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the copy of Quandrix Command, returning Dualcaster Mage from the battlefield to your hand and putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Branching Evolution.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-4690-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Phylath, adding {C}{C}.
When Phylath dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Phylath from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Phylath enters, it triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

3151-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Elvish Archdruid does not have summoning sickness. You control at least four Elves.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Elvish Archdruid
3151-5200.description:
Activate Elvish Archdruid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Elvish Archdruid
Repeat.
3151-5200.notes:
Once you have infinite mana, you may equip Sword of the Paruns to any creature you control and untap them infinite times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.
